doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Dexter Gordon, nicknamed Big Stoop
summary: Hamilton remembers Dexter Gordon as a tall kid called Big Stoop from a wealthy doctor's family, who played clarinet then.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Dexter got one, myself, you know. We used to talk about it all the time.
When did you meet Dexter? How old were you when you met Dexter?
We used to cal him Big Stoop.
Remember Big Stoop in Terry and the Pirates, that cartoon strip?
Oh, yeah, yeah, Terry and the -- okay, yeah, okay. With Big Stoop, huh?
We used to call him Big Stoop. Can you imagine a 12 or 13-year old kid being six feet tall at that time?
He was long tall Dex already.
You know, Dexter grew up in -- his family was wealthy.
Oh they were, okay. So he wasn’t -­
His father was a doctor, you know, and I think he grew up on the west side or something like -- you know, but he was cool.
But you met in high school?
Yeah, but now he had a clarinet at that time.
